THE ONE CAMPAIGN PAGE (on the farm).
All the money lives here: four costed builds (hatchery, feed mill, solar, cold room), the naming ladder from a single hen up to a whole build, honest legal wording, Flutterwave checkout. Green = the working farm.

HOW kisi.africa SENDS PEOPLE HERE.
A persistent bridge strip, an in-story CTA at the end of any arc that touches a real build, and a footer badge. Republic indigo/gold hands off to the farm's green. It advertises; the farm page closes.
